Recorded claim:
`browser_viewTelemetry.js` hung in `add_setup` because default-calendar mutation raced Calendar delayed startup; await `window.delayedStartupPromise` before telemetry checks or Calendar state mutation. Delayed startup awaits `loadCalendarComponent()`, which initializes `calendarDeactivator`. [Task 2]
